name: Search Issues
description: Search for issues in a repository with a query. [See the documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html#list-issues)

configurable_props.name: projectId
configurable_props.label: Project ID
configurable_props.description: The project ID, as displayed in the main project page

configurable_props.name: search
configurable_props.label: Search Query
configurable_props.description: Search issues against their **title** and **description**. Leave this field blank to list all issues

configurable_props.name: labels
configurable_props.label: Labels
configurable_props.description: A list of label names. Issues must have all labels to be returned. `None` lists all issues with no labels. `Any` lists all issues with at least one label

configurable_props.name: state
configurable_props.label: Issue State
configurable_props.description: Return `all` issues or just those that are `opened` or `closed`

configurable_props.name: assigneeId
configurable_props.label: Assignee Username
configurable_props.description: Return issues assigned to the given username

configurable_props.name: max
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: Max number of results to return. Default value is `100`
